parameters.jsonBody: {"statements": [{"statement": "CREATE CONSTRAINT track_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (t:Track) REQUIRE t.track_id IS UNIQUE"}, {"statement": "CREATE CONSTRAINT album_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (a:Album) REQUIRE a.album_id IS UNIQUE"}, {"statement": "CREATE CONSTRAINT artist_name IF NOT EXISTS FOR (a:Artist) REQUIRE a.name IS UNIQUE"}, {"statement": "CREATE CONSTRAINT genre_name IF NOT EXISTS FOR (g:Genre) REQUIRE g.name IS UNIQUE"}, {"statement": "CREATE CONSTRAINT subgenre_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (s:Subgenre) REQUIRE s.id IS UNIQUE"}, {"statement": "CREATE CONSTRAINT year_value IF NOT EXISTS FOR (y:Year) REQUIRE y.value IS UNIQUE"}, {"statement": "CREATE VECTOR INDEX track_vibe_index IF NOT EXISTS FOR (t:Track) ON (t.embedding) OPTIONS {indexConfig: {`vector.dimensions`: 1536, `vector.similarity_function`: 'cosine'}}"}]}

{"statements": [{"statement": "MATCH (t:Track) CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('track_vibe_index', 6, t.embedding) YIELD node, score WHERE node <> t AND score >= 0.85 MERGE (t)-[r:SIMILAR_TO]->(node) SET r.score = score"}]}
